description: This file defines XML-based service definitions for picklist-related operations in an OFBiz framework application, including services for finding orders to pick, assembling order info, creating picklists, printing pick sheets, editing picklist items, and generating picklist reports.

methods.name: findOrdersToPickMove
methods.description: Finds orders ready for picking or requiring stock moves based on filtering criteria and grouping options.

methods.name: assembleOrderHeaderInfoInline
methods.description: Assembles detailed order header information, including inventory reservations, stock status, and order item details.

methods.name: createPicklistFromOrders
methods.description: Creates a picklist from orders identified for picking and associated inventory stock reservation.

methods.name: printPickSheets
methods.description: Generates pick sheets (labels) for orders within a specified group for manual picking.

methods.name: editPicklistItem
methods.description: Allows editing a picklist item, such as lot linkage and quantity, with validation checks.

methods.name: setPicklistItemToComplete
methods.description: Marks a picklist item as completed.

methods.name: getPicklistDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for displaying picklist summaries and details.
